design_string: half-eternity BAND - NO center stone, NO head, NO basket, NO gallery, NO halo. Thin 14K yellow-gold band. Front half carries an alternating run of STEP-CUT BAGUETTE diamonds and ROUND BRILLIANT diamonds: each single baguette is BAR-SET lengthwise ALONG the band between two flat polished gold bars, separated by groups of THREE round brilliants in shared/common two-prong settings. Centre front reads exactly BAGUETTE, ROUND, ROUND, ROUND, BAGUETTE, round groups continuing outward onto both shoulders. Rear half of the shank is plain polished yellow gold, thin round comfort profile. No pave, no milgrain, no channel, no bezel.
